project_metadata.title: CA Yogesh Pannalal Trivedi — Independent Finance Review & Fractional CFO Landing Page
project_metadata.award_target: Awwwards Site of the Day / FWA / CSS Design Awards
project_metadata.theme_strategy: Editorial Swiss Luxury meets High-Precision Financial Engineering. Light cream background (#F8F7F4 / #F1EFE8) with deep navy (#042C53), architectural pine green (#0F6E56), and ice blue/mint dynamic accents (#E1F5EE, #85B7EB). Toggleable smooth dark mode supported.

design_concepts_probability_matrix.concept_name: The Editorial Swiss Ledger & Kinetic Architect
disciplines_fused: High-End Financial Publishing (Financial Times / Monocle style)
design_concepts_probability_matrix.description: Combines asymmetrical high-contrast grid structures with hyper-refined typography (Cinzel / Newsreader / Cabinet Grotesk), kinetic micro-line charts, tactile card outlines, and high-speed reveal choreography.
Uses monolithic borderless cards, deep obsidian & dark navy contrasts, heavy metallic accents, and interactive audit scanners.
Integrates organic muted mint & sage tones with mathematical balance, vintage financial seals, and floating financial node diagrams.
High-density grid layout with glowing neon telemetry, dark navy glassmorphism, and instant interactive audit calculators.
Ultra-spacious white space, massive headline typography with paper texture grain overlays and quiet luxury motion.

guidelines: Never use pure black #000000; use Deep Navy #042C53 for high-contrast text.
Background uses warm editorial light cream #F8F7F4 with section variations in #F1EFE8 and #042C53.
Primary call-to-action buttons use Deep Navy with Pine Green hover states or vice-versa.
Dark callout sections ('Automate the routine. Keep the judgement human.') use #042C53 background with crisp #E1F5EE mint typography.

layout_and_grid.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing system using p-8, p-12, py-24, py-32 for breathing room.
layout_and_grid.bento_grid_mode: Tetris Grid Mode A (Asymmetrical tension for storytelling)

sections.layout: 2-column dynamic split with kinetic text staggered mask-reveal on left and framed executive spotlight card on right.
Full-width editorial ribbon running slow continuous ticker with key capabilities & metrics.
4-column high-density stat counter grid with subtle vertical dividers and interactive hover depth.
Editorial column with asymmetrical pull-quote and highlighted key phrases.
2x2 Bento Grid of problem cards with provocative question headers, mint tags, and hover reveal details.
3-column interactive feature card matrix with icon accents and live value metrics.
4-step horizontal timeline / accordion flow with step numbers (01 to 04).
Full-bleed Deep Navy banner with ambient radial glow, bold typography, and interactive AI model badges.
3-column outcome cards with dynamic metric tags (e.g., '150+ to <120 days', '80% recovered').
Vertical timeline with year badges (2009–2026), role titles, company scale, and expandable details.
Split section: Left side credentials badge pill wall; Right side interactive tech stack matrix (ERPNext, PowerBI, Excel, Claude AI).
High-impact booking section with direct contact cards, fast email copy button, and interactive financial health check drawer.

sequence: Step 1 (0.0s): Top sticky nav slides down smoothly with opacity 0 -> 1.
Step 2 (0.2s): Eyebrow 'Independent finance review · Fractional CFO · Dubai' fades in with horizontal line tracking.
Step 3 (0.4s): H1 Headline reveals phrase by phrase using clip-path overflow hidden mask.
Step 4 (0.7s): Subtitle paragraph and CTA button group stagger up with spring dynamics.
Step 5 (0.9s): Right-side executive photo frame expands from 0.95 scale with a warm gold & pine green spotlight border accent.

motion_and_scrollytelling.lenis_smooth_scroll: Mandatory smooth momentum scrolling initialized globally.

photography_and_media.portrait_treatment: Executive spotlight treatment: Monochrome / warm-toned high-contrast executive framing with geometric accent grid background, gold/pine stroke border, and subtle noise grain overlay.

testing_attributes.convention: kebab-case data-testid for all interactive elements

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page landing page for CA Yogesh Pannalal Trivedi using React and Tailwind CSS.
Use Google Fonts Cormorant Garamond / Plus Jakarta Sans / JetBrains Mono.
Ensure Lenis smooth momentum scrolling is initialized on mount.
Ensure framer-motion is used for stagger reveals and micro-hover interactions.
Implement the floating Claude AI chat widget with interactive quick prompts (e.g., 'What is a Fractional CFO rate?', 'How do you fix UAE VAT drift?', 'Book a Health Check').
All buttons and interactive cards MUST contain proper data-testid attributes.
Save design guidelines file strictly at /app/design_guidelines.json.
